# ponytail

"Lazy senior dev" mode: the simplest code that works (YAGNI, stdlib first, smallest diff). On in every session via a SessionStart hook.

- Source: https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail
- Type: plugin

```sh
claude plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail
claude plugin install ponytail@ponytail
```

Use: always on; `/ponytail lite|full|ultra`, `/ponytail-review`, `/ponytail-audit`; "stop ponytail" to turn off.
